# EoStudio

> llms.txt for the EoStudio repository (embeddedos-org/EoStudio).
> Status: the visual design IDE for EmbeddedOS — UI, 3D, CAD,
> games and hardware design surfaces, with an Agent Skills
> catalog and AI-assisted workflows.

EoStudio is the developer-tooling face of the EmbeddedOS
ecosystem: the environment in which EoS applications, boards
and interfaces are designed, with project templates, editors,
code generation and plugin surfaces.
